content:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT PB-39281 — auth-service: high rate of token reuse / 401-after-200 pattern at edge-proxy. Paging @Elena (on-call) and security-IR.

Elena (on-call): I'm on it. I see a spike in validation failures starting 2024-11-07T02:12:10Z. Pulling traces and recent deploys.

Akeem SRE: Noticed same. Replays from a small set of IPs across regions. Could be leaked session tokens being replayed.

Elena (on-call): Querying logs for token fingerprint ->
```
# quick query (internal kibana)
index: auth-logs-* | where event=="token_validate" and status==401 | stats count by token_hash, src_ip
-- results: token_hash=abcd1234, src_ip=[3.8.23.11, 34.97.200.5, 18.204.4.12]
```

Security-IR: Start containment: 1) block src_ip list at edge WAF 2) rotate SSO signing key (short window) 3) invalidate active sessions for affected tokens/customers. Recommend patching any debug log pipelines too.

Elena (on-call): Blocking the three IPs now at the edge rules. Applying rule id: edge-block-39281.

deploybot: edge policy updated -> rule edge-block-39281 applied (propagated to 6 regions). :white_check_mark:

Akeem SRE: We should revoke the token batch and force reauth for sessions issued in the last 6 hours. I can run a targeted revoke call.

Elena (on-call): Preparing revoke. Runbook snippet to invalidate sessions:
```
# internal auth admin
curl -X POST "https://auth-admin.internal/revoke" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"token_hashes": ["abcd1234"], "reason":"suspected exfil"}'
```

Security-IR: Also rotate SSO signing key. Plan: create new key, deploy to auth service, issue short-lived tokens for 15m, then flip and revoke old. Customer-facing session will require reauth. Notify CS.

Customer Success: Heads-up: we'll need a terse outbound for affected tenants. How many customers impacted?

Elena (on-call): Early estimate ~12 tenant sessions attempted with replay; I/O indicates ~1200 total attempts but likely limited to a handful of customers. I'm running a per-tenant impact query.

Tim Eng: Any deploys to auth or proxy in last 24h? If so, we should roll back suspicious change.

Akeem SRE: No auth code deploys in last 24h. Proxy had a minor config push but looks unrelated. Traces show identical token hashes used from multiple IPs -> suggests token leak rather than bug.

Security-IR: Elena, when you start key rotation, we'll coordinate legal and CS messaging. Legal: can you standby for data exposure assessment?

Legal: Available. If token material allowed access to PII, we'll escalate. Otherwise standard notification template.

Elena (on-call): Initiating key rotation step 1: generate new key on KMS and stage in auth staging.

Elena (on-call): Deployed new signing key to auth service instances in canary region. Quick smoke: token issuance ok.

Elena (on-call): Flipping signing key now (prod). Will mark old key for revocation in 5m.

deploybot: auth-service rollout v2.14.8 -> canary ok -> global rollout started.

Security-IR: After flip, start targeted revoke for token_hash abcd1234 and any other high-count hashes. Use correlation to tenant ids.

Elena (on-call): Revokes issued. Example revoke call returned 200 for hashes: [abcd1234, ef56gh78].

Customer Success: Preparing a short advisory for affected tenants: limited session interruptions, forced sign-in, recommended rotating service credentials.

Legal: Hold on messaging until IR confirms whether tokens grant access to customer data. Estimated 30-45m for full forensics.

Akeem SRE: Blocking rules and rotation appear to have reduced replay attempts by 95% in 10 minutes.

Elena (on-call): Current impact summary: forced sign-in for ~12 customers, transient 401s for others. No evidence yet of data exfil beyond token reuse. Continuing forensic collection (traces + S3 access logs).

Security-IR: Next actions: complete forensics, preserve logs for 90 days, coordinate CS + Legal + Exec if scope grows. Pager will escalate if we see replays continue.

pagerbot: Incident PB-39281 status -> containment: in-progress; severity: P2; notified teams: SRE/SEC/CS/Legal.

Elena (on-call): Handing off to Security-IR for root-cause and customer comms. I'm staying on to help with logs. :thumbsup:

Security-IR: Akeem and I will continue. If anyone spots additional token_hashes with >10 replays, drop them here.

Customer Success: Thanks — we'll draft messages and queue customer notifications for review by Legal.

Elena (on-call): ETA for full incident report (initial): 6 hours. Will update thread with final impact numbers and RCA.

Tim Eng: Good job team. Keep updates short and action-focused.

pagerbot: Closing paging window (auto) — remain in thread for updates.
